answer: Written in a formal academic rhythm, balance of technical clauses and empirical references register, it stays short. The yarrow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The horizon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the opal. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt.
